_header: Photoreal prompt recipe: the default prompt template of the Director Workbench (request_create recipe, the Queue's request form). Why each block exists, the sources and what is verified: docs/PHOTOREAL.md. Copied from videoclip-research/photoreal_recipe.json (2026-10-04); edit here. Prices: js/prices.js is the workbench's price table (per_model.cost_* below is the research snapshot).
notes: Default prompt template for photoreal generation requests. Join the still blocks in order with a single space. Placeholders are {curly}. Blocks marked required:false may be dropped when empty. Prices are fal list prices read 2026-10-04. Character-agnostic: no block names a gender; {name} is the entity name and {constants} its identity constants (entity.constants[]: the details that must stay identical), which js/recipe.js puts into the identity lock. A field fills its block and keeps the fixed sentences; an edited block replaces the whole block.

blocks.use_when: any request with reference images (edit endpoints)
blocks.template: Image {n_face} is a close-up of {name}'s face, Image {n_body} is {name}'s full body{extra_refs}. Create a new photograph of the same person as Image {n_face}.
blocks.example: Image 1 is a close-up of Ada's face, Image 2 is Ada's full body, Image 3 is the hair clip, Image 4 is the office. Create a new photograph of the same person as Image 1.

blocks.use_when: a real person or approved character is in frame
blocks.template: Keep the face exactly as in Image {n_face}: bone structure, eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, hairline and body proportions. Keep these exactly the same: {constants}. Do not beautify, slim or de-age.
blocks.example: Keep the face exactly as in Image 1: bone structure, eye shape, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, hairline and body proportions. Keep these exactly the same: the mole on the left cheek; an orange (#D97757) starburst enamel clip above the LEFT ear. Do not beautify, slim or de-age.
blocks.fill: {constants} = the entity's constants[] joined with "; " (no constants: "marks" goes into the feature list instead)

rules: name materials (matte cotton, wool, enamel, brushed metal)
give exact colours or hex for props
blocks.example: Full-body photograph of Ada, wearing a black long-sleeved cotton shirt-dress under a cream cotton pinafore, slightly creased at the waist, and a small orange (#F26B1D) starburst enamel hair clip above the left temple.
Ada stands relaxed with the weight on one leg, one hand loosely at the side, looking just past the camera with a calm, tired expression.

rules: list 3-5 ordinary objects and some wear
blocks.example: Location: an empty open-plan office at dawn, grey carpet tiles, rows of desks with monitors switched off, a chair pushed out, cable trays under the windows.

blocks.template: Light: {key_source} from {direction}, {colour_temp}, {hardness}; {secondary}; {practicals}. The same light falls on the subject and the place, with matching shadows and a soft contact shadow at the feet.
blocks.example: Light: cool blue pre-dawn daylight through the windows camera-left, soft and low; a thin warm orange sunrise glow on the horizon rims the hair; ceiling lights off, the right side of the room falls into shadow. The same light falls on the subject and the place, with matching shadows and a soft contact shadow at the feet.

defaults.full_body: full-frame camera, 35mm, f/2.8, about 4 m away, chest height
defaults.medium: full-frame camera, 50mm, f/2.8, about 2 m away, eye level
defaults.close_up: full-frame camera, 85mm, f/2, about 1.2 m away, eye level

blocks.example: Shot on a full-frame camera, 35mm lens at f/2.8, about 4 m away at chest height, 1/60 s, ISO 1600.

blocks.template: Visible skin texture with pores, fine lines and slight natural redness, {texture_field: hair_detail, fabric_detail}.
blocks.example: Visible skin texture with pores, fine lines and slight natural redness, a few flyaway hairs, visible cotton weave and small creases in the fabric.

options_grade: natural colour and accurate white balance
Cinestill 800T colour with halation around lights (night)
blocks.example: Unretouched documentary photograph, natural colour, fine high-ISO sensor noise in the shadows.

still.full_example: Full-body photograph of a man in his fifties with short grey hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a navy wool coat over a grey crew-neck jumper. He leans against a tiled wall, weight on one leg, looking down at his phone. Location: a Barcelona metro platform late at night, scuffed tiles, a bench, a timetable screen, a yellow safety line. Light: cold overhead fluorescent tubes, slightly greenish, hard shadows under the brows and chin, a warm sign glow from the right. The same light falls on the subject and the place. Shot on a full-frame camera, 35mm lens at f/2.8, about 4 m away, ISO 3200. Visible skin texture with pores, fine lines and slight natural redness, wool pilling. Unretouched documentary photograph, natural colour, fine sensor noise.

principles: name every reference and its job
describe people by description, not pronoun, on Flux Kontext
re-attach the original identity refs every 5-8 edits; never edit an edit more than ~8 times
use a mask endpoint (fal-ai/flux-pro/v1/fill) when face pixels must not change

templates.add_prop: Using Image 1, add {prop} {position}. {prop_details}. Light it with the same {light} as the hair and face, with a small matching shadow. Keep the face, hair, pose, clothes, background and framing exactly the same.
templates.change_wardrobe: Using Image 1, change only the {garment} to {new_garment_with_material}, fitted naturally to the body and pose with realistic folds. Keep the face, hairstyle, skin, body proportions, pose, background and lighting exactly the same.
templates.prop_from_ref: Image 1 is {name}, Image 2 is the {prop}. Put the {prop} from Image 2 {position}, copying its exact shape and colour at about {size}. Keep everything else in Image 1 exactly the same.
templates.sketch_guided: Replace the {colour} scribble in Image 1 with {object}, real material and correct scale, lit by the scene's light. Keep everything else exactly the same.
templates.relight: Keep the subject, pose and framing exactly. Relight the scene as {source} from {direction}, {colour_temp}; add {shadow} on the {side} side of the face; match the background to the same light.
templates.place_in_location: Image 1 is {name}, Image 2 is the location. Photograph the same person as Image 1 {pose} in the place shown in Image 2, at correct scale, lit by Image 2's light ({light}), with contact shadows on the floor. Keep the face, hair and body exactly as in Image 1.
templates.skin_cleanup: Retouch lightly: reduce temporary blemishes and shine only. Keep pores, moles, freckles, asymmetry and natural texture. Do not change face shape, eye size, nose or jaw.

identity_lock_phrases: Keep the facial features exactly the same as Image 1.
Do not beautify, slim, de-age or change the face shape.

rules: describe motion, not what the image already shows
5-6 s default; 10-15 s only with timed beats
face medium-size or larger when identity matters
avoid fast head turns, profile turns, hands crossing the face
video.template: {subject_motion}. Camera: {camera_move}. {ambient_motion}. Handheld documentary footage, natural motion blur, fine film grain, real skin texture, stable face and identity throughout.
video.timed_template: [0-{t1}s] {beat1}. [{t1}-{t2}s] {beat2}. Camera: {camera_move}. Handheld documentary footage, natural motion blur, fine film grain, stable face.
camera_moves: slow tracking shot alongside the subject
video.example: Ada lifts the head and glances toward the window, takes a slow breath, a strand of hair moves. Camera: slow push-in. Dawn light slowly warms on the carpet. Handheld documentary footage, natural motion blur, fine film grain, real skin texture, stable face and identity throughout.
video.negative_prompt: morphing face, changing identity, plastic skin, smooth skin, warped hands, extra fingers, flicker, cartoon, CGI, 3D render, text, watermark
video.end_frame: Make the end frame by editing the start frame (same light, lens, location, wardrobe); change only pose, expression or camera position. For loops set end = start.

motion_control.reference_video: 3-30 s, single continuous shot, one person, no cuts, no camera move, steady moderate motion, similar framing to the still
motion_control.image: whole body and head visible, unoccluded, >5% of frame, same framing as the video

character_orientation.video: up to 30 s, supports face element
character_orientation.image: up to 10 s, allows prompted camera moves

motion_control.prompt: Describe background and atmosphere only, e.g. 'empty office at dawn, cool window light, slow dust in the air'.

replace_with.cinematic lighting: name the source, direction and colour temperature

post.how: faithful upscaler (SeedVR2 or Topaz-style); avoid creative/hallucinating upscalers on faces
match white balance and contrast across shots of the same scene
vignette strength low; chromatic aberration 0.5-1 px; optional slight barrel (parabolize)
only if needed, CAS at low strength; never on top of an AI upscale
last; uniform fine grain matched to stated ISO/stock (kodak/fuji/analog style)
JPEG quality ~90 for stills; for video apply the same grain/CA to every clip in the edit
face-embedding cosine vs real reference photos; reject below threshold

nano_banana_2.notes: Default for identity stills and edits. Full-sentence prompts; no negative field, use positive phrasing. Use seed for reproducibility, thinking_level 'high' for complex multi-ref edits. Re-anchor refs every 5-8 edits.

seedream_5_pro_edit.notes: Cinematic/dramatic realism, sketch-guided edits. Push imperfection words harder (skin is smoother than Seedream 4.5). No seed: not reproducible.

flux_2_pro_edit.notes: Subject+Action+Style+Context, front-load key words, 30-80 words. No negative prompts. Hex colours bound to objects. Can use LoRA via FLUX.2 routes.

flux_kontext_max_multi.notes: Surgical single edits. Describe the person, don't use pronouns; 'change X to Y' rather than 'transform'. Skin tends to look cleaner/AI; add texture words.

qwen_image_edit_2511.notes: Cheap local edits; vague edits can re-cast the face. LoRA trainer on fal ~$4/1000 steps.

minimax_h3_max_i2v.notes: Default I2V. Describe motion only; timed beats [0-3s]; give each reference a job; first+last frame endpoint available.

kling_v3_pro_i2v.notes: Use elements for identity across angle changes; explicit shot type + one camera move; set generate_audio false when audio comes from the song.

kling_v3_motion_control.notes: Clean single-person phone clip, no cuts or camera moves; match framing between still and clip.

identity.lock_phrase: Same person as Image 1. Keep the facial features exactly the same as Image 1.
identity.recommendation: No LoRA by default: LoRAs do not work with NB2, Seedream, Kling or H3. Use the reference pack + lock phrase + embedding QA; if identity still drifts, try a Phota profile ($2.90) before training a FLUX LoRA.
